name: io.github.Lory97/tag-per-track-mcp
title: Tag-per-Track
description: Audio analysis and A&R scoring for music tracks: tags, lyrics, artist stats, demo triage.

environmentVariables.name: TAG_PER_TRACK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Studio API key (tpt_live_...) generated on https://tag-per-track.cloud. Consumes prepaid credits, no crypto wallet needed. Takes priority over the wallet mode.

environmentVariables.name: WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated Base burner wallet (66 hex chars starting with 0x) for USDC micro-payments via x402. Used only when no API key is set.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_SPENDING_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Client-side spending cap per request in USDC (wallet mode).

environmentVariables.name: TAG_PER_TRACK_NO_PERSIST
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 or true to keep API-key analyses out of your dashboard history.
